_comments.project_name: Human-readable name for this migration project.
_comments.target_repo_path: Relative path from this L2L repo root to the legacy app repo.
_comments.source_stack: Describes what the app is built on TODAY — do not change after audit.
_comments.target_stack: Describes the modernization target — what you are migrating TO.
_comments.scoring.cve_weight: Max points awarded for resolving all CVEs found during audit (0-100, weights must sum to 100).
_comments.scoring.test_coverage_weight: Max points for reaching 100% contract test coverage.
_comments.scoring.api_enablement_weight: Max points for full REST API surface alongside legacy controllers.
_comments.scoring.complexity_weight: Max points for eliminating all cyclomatic complexity violations.
_comments.scoring.framework_currency_weight: Max points for completing the framework migration to target_stack.
